C0818.title: Second-Instance Criminal Ruling in Jin Moumou's Computer System Sabotage Case
C0818.summary: A Beijing court ruling and public reporting show that a Baidu employee, dissatisfied after a project was handed over to someone else, deliberately tampered with a database. The court found the conduct constituted sabotaging a computer information system and imposed a criminal sentence. The case shows how insider data tampering can disrupt system operation and create enterprise management, service-stability, and data-integrity risk.
